title: Deconversion Can Cost You Everything—Here’s Why

top_liked.author: @Twinklboo
top_liked.text: My kids gave up christianity before I did. I actually owe it to them, that I can see! The word, REPENT, used to make me feel like a worm in church. Now I know the true meaning of REPENT and I have CHANGED MY MIND...😂.

top_liked.author: @kevchard5214
top_liked.text: After all of these facts christians still scream they are being persecuted because someone doesn't believe their lies.

top_liked.author: @David-x2q5n
top_liked.text: It's about knowledge. There's no going back with knowledge. You can't step into the same river twice. Even if I miss the community of believers, I know I won't be able to think on their level. I won't pray with them or read the Bible or pretend to be interested in their religion.
